```{r}
#this runs on R4.1.0
#load data from leptin treated
#hashtag1 ARCH3H, hashtag2 PVH3H, hashtag5 ARCH24h, hashtag6 PVH24h, hashtag7 ARCH72h, hashtag8 PVH72H 

all_singlets = readRDS(paste0(save_dir, "leptin_allcell_sinlgets.rds"))
pvh_leptin <- subset(all_singlets, idents = c("Hashtag2","Hashtag6","Hashtag8"))
dim(pvh_leptin)
#[1] 23820  3649
rm(all_singlets)
pvh_leptin <- NormalizeData(pvh_leptin, normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000)

#load data from OB
pvh_ob = readRDS(paste0(save_dir, "ob_PVH_sinlgets.rds"))
pvh_ob <- NormalizeData(pvh_ob, normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000)

#load data from WT
pvh_wt = readRDS(paste0(save_dir, "wt_PVH_sinlgets.rds"))
pvh_wt <- NormalizeData(pvh_wt, normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000)
```

```{R batch_correction}
#integrate the three conditions with batch corrected 
pvh.list = list(pvh_ob, pvh_wt, pvh_leptin)

#Slc32a1 is in the expression
all_genes <- lapply(pvh.list, row.names) %>% Reduce(intersect, .)
all_genes = all_genes[1:(length(all_genes)-2)] #remove hashtags here?

#"Slc32a1" does not in top 4000 variable genes
pvh.anchors <- FindIntegrationAnchors(object.list = pvh.list, anchor.features = all_genes)

#renaming 
pvh.combined <- IntegrateData(anchorset = pvh.anchors, features = all_genes)

#standard RNA processing
DefaultAssay(pvh.combined) = "integrated"
pvh.combined = ScaleData(pvh.combined, verbose = FALSE)
pvh.combined <- RunPCA(pvh.combined, npcs = 50, verbose = FALSE)
ElbowPlot(pvh.combined) #take 30PC
pvh.combined <- RunUMAP(pvh.combined, reduction = "pca", dims = 1:20)
pvh.combined <- FindNeighbors(pvh.combined, reduction = "pca", dims = 1:20)
pvh.combined <- FindClusters(pvh.combined, resolution = 0.55)

#hashtag1 ARCH3H, hashtag2 PVH3H, hashtag5 ARCH24h, hashtag6 PVH24h, hashtag7 ARCH72h, hashtag8 PVH72H 
pvh.combined@meta.data$time = ''
hashtag_list = paste0('Hashtag',c(1,5,7, 2,6,8))
reg_time = c(paste0('ARC', c('3h', '24h','72h')),paste0('PVH', c('3h', '24h','72h')))
conv_table =data.frame(hashtag_list, reg_time)

for (i in 4:6) {
  pvh.combined@meta.data[which(pvh.combined@meta.data$orig.ident == "leptin" & pvh.combined@meta.data$Hashtag_classification == conv_table$hashtag_list[i]),  'time'] = conv_table$reg_time[i]
}

pvh.combined@meta.data$condition = paste0(pvh.combined@meta.data$orig.ident, pvh.combined@meta.data$time)

p1 <- DimPlot(pvh.combined, reduction = "umap", group.by = "condition")
p2 <- DimPlot(pvh.combined, reduction = "umap", label = TRUE, repel = TRUE)
p1 + p2

#plot by cell percentage
ggplot(pvh.combined@meta.data, aes(x=seurat_clusters, fill=condition)) + geom_bar(position = "fill") + theme_bw()

#specific gene expression
#look at one gene
my_cols = RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(5, "Paired")
#VlnPlot(pvh.combined, features = "Crh", split.by = "condition", group.by = "seurat_clusters", pt.size = 0, combine = FALSE, cols = my_cols)
FeaturePlot(pvh.combined, features = "Crh")
VlnPlot(pvh.combined, features = "Crh")

saveRDS(pvh.combined, file = paste0(save_dir, "pvh.combined_111621.RDS"))
```

```{r construct gene regulatory network}
library(epoch)
library(singleCellNet)

pvh.combined = readRDS(paste0(save_dir, "pvh.combined_111621.RDS"))
metadata = read.csv("metadata_pvh_pt.csv")
rownames(metadata) = as.vector(metadata$cellID)

#find HVG
pvh.combined <- FindVariableFeatures(pvh.combined , selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 4000)

expDat<-pvh.combined@assays$RNA@counts
expDat = expDat[rowSums(expDat)!=0,] #remove dropout genes
sampTab<-metadata

# Find TFs
mmTFs<-utils_loadObject(paste0(save_dir,"/mmTFs.rda"))
#mmTFs<-intersect(rownames(expDat),mmTFs)

# Only look at neurons
#sampTab_neuron = sampTab[which(sampTab$seurat_clusters %in% c(3,6,7,8,11,14,15,16,18,20,21,22)),]
#expDat_neuron = as.matrix(expDat[VariableFeatures(pvh.combined),rownames(sampTab_neuron)])

sampTab_neuron = sampTab[which(sampTab$seurat_clusters %in% c(5)),]
expDat_neuron = as.matrix(expDat[VariableFeatures(pvh.combined),rownames(sampTab_neuron)])
#downsample and log-transform data

expDat_neuron = trans_prop(expDat_neuron, total = 10000, dThresh = 0.25)
expDat_neuron = expDat_neuron[rowSums(expDat_neuron)>0,]
# Find dynamically expressed genes
xdyn <- findDynGenes(expDat_neuron, sampTab_neuron, group_column="seurat_clusters", pseudotime_column="velocity_pseudotime")
pThresh<-0.01
dgenes<-names(xdyn$genes)[xdyn$genes<pThresh]

mmTFs<-intersect(rownames(expDat_neuron),mmTFs)

# Reconstruct and perform crossweighting
grnDF <- reconstructGRN(expDat_neuron, mmTFs, dgenes, method="pearson", zThresh=3)
grnDF <- crossweight(grnDF,expDat_neuron,xdyn,filter_thresh=0)

xdyn<-define_epochs(xdyn,expDat_neuron,method="pseudotime",num_epochs=3)
epoch_assignments<-assign_epochs(expDat_neuron,xdyn)
dynamic_grn<-epochGRN(grnDF,epoch_assignments)

#influential TFs
gene_rank<-compute_pagerank(dynamic_grn,weight_column="weighted_score")
another_gene_rank<-compute_betweenness_degree(dynamic_grn,weight_column="weighted_score")

#add interactions
dynamic_grn<-add_interaction_type(dynamic_grn)
community_assignments<-find_communities(dynamic_grn)

# First, smooth expression for a cleaner plot
ccells <- xdyn$cells
expSmoothed <- grnKsmooth(expDat_neuron, ccells, BW=0.03)

# Plot a heatmap of the dynamic TFs
tfstoplot<-intersect(dgenes,mmTFs)
dynTFs<-xdyn
dynTFs$genes<-dynTFs$genes[names(dynTFs$genes) %in% tfstoplot]

pdf("~/Desktop/pvh_cluster5_top20_dynamicTF.pdf")
hm_dyn(expSmoothed,dynTFs,topX=20)
dev.off()

#plot dynamic network
plot_dynamic_network(dynamic_grn,mmTFs,only_TFs=TRUE,order=c("epoch1..epoch1","epoch2..epoch2","epoch3..epoch3"))

pdf("~/Desktop/top5TFs_pvh.pdf")
plot_top_regulators(dynamic_grn, gene_rank, mmTFs, numTopTFs=5, only_TFs=FALSE,order=c("epoch1..epoch1","epoch2..epoch2","epoch3..epoch3"))
dev.off()
```
